entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, my ID is 301. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac... I... I think I need to return something? It's a VeloBand tracker. I'm just so confused by the website. I got it a few weeks ago but everything's been a mess.

I can certainly help you look into that. I'm sorry to hear things have been hectic. To understand better, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, no, it's not broken. The box isn't even really open. My husband... he had a medical emergency right after it arrived. He needed unexpected surgery and was in the hospital for almost three weeks. I just... I couldn't even think about setting up a new gadget. Can't you just help me?

I'm very sorry to hear about your husband's health. I completely understand, and I hope he's recovering well. Please don't worry, let me pull up your account and see what we can do. Can I get your order number or the email address you used for the purchase?
Yes, it's... it's vipcustomer@email.com. I'm sorry, I'm just so overwhelmed.
Not a problem at all. Thank you. I see your order here... delivered on December 15th. Let me just check the return policy for you. One moment.
Okay, I've got it. It looks like you're well within the return window. Our policy allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery.
Oh, really? Ninety days? That's... that's such a relief. I was so worried I had missed it with everything going on.

Absolutely. Given the emergency you've dealt with, I'm glad this is one less thing for you to worry about. I have processed the return approval for a full refund. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to your email now.
Thank you, Isaac. Thank you so much. You've been a huge help.

You are very welcome. And as you're one of our VIP members, and to make things just a little bit easier after your stressful time, I've also added a $50 store credit to your VeloFit account. There's no expiry on it. Please feel free to use it if you decide to try another product in the future when things have settled down.
Wow. I... I don't know what to say. That's incredibly kind. Thank you.
It's our pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've solved it all. Thank you again.
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I wish your husband a speedy recovery.
